```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Data from your table ----
df <- data.frame(
  symptom = factor(sprintf("%02d", 1:9), levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:9)),
  hyper_HI = c(11, 1, 0, 2, 6, 1, 2, 0, 2),
  inat_I   = c(2, 10, 2, 8, 2, 8, 0, 1, 1)
)

# Convert to long format for ggplot
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(hyper_HI, inat_I),
               names_to = "subtype",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(subtype = recode(subtype,
                          "hyper_HI" = "ADHD-HI",
                          "inat_I"   = "ADHD-I"))

# ---- Plot ----
mapped_plot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = symptom, y = count, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pink", "#A8D08D")) +
  labs(x = "Symptom ID",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Subtype",
       title = "Distribution of Mapped Sentences by Symptom and Subtype",
       subtitle = "By Symptom and Subtype") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",

    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "lightyellow", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightyellow", colour = NA)
  )

#ggsave("/Users/matildeelene/Desktop/Bachelors/StereoSet-master/plots/mapped_plot.png", mapped_plot, width = 7, height = 6)

```

```{r}
# 1. Load your data
file_path <- "~/Desktop/Bachelors/StereoSet-master/platania_et_al/adhd_c_platania.csv"  # <- update path
platania <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Compute total frequency and get top 5 per subtype
platania_top5 <- platania %>%
  mutate(total_freq = male_freq + female_freq) %>%      # total endorsement
  group_by(subtype) %>%                                 # ADHD-I vs ADHD-HI
  arrange(desc(total_freq), .by_group = TRUE) %>%       # sort within subtype
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%                                 # keep top 5 per subtype
  ungroup()

# 3. Inspect or export
View(platania_top5)   # or print(platania_top5)

# Optional: save to a new CSV
write.csv(platania_top5,
          "~/Desktop/Bachelors/StereoSet-master/platania_et_al/adhd_c_platania_top5.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
